Message:
[SCSI] lpfc 8.3.20: Critical fixes

- Use for iocbq->context1 to hold the ndlp pointer.
- Set ndlp in all iocbs generated from ioctl functions.
- Turn parity and serr bits back on after performing sli4 board reset.
